chain.title: Somewhere to Set It Down
chain.desc: Iron plates alone. Every solid product in this mod is a fluid poured into a tray and then pressed, so nothing crystallises until you have a stack of these.

chain.title: Crushing Limestone
chain.desc: Create's crushing wheels on limestone, matched by block or by the whole stone_types/limestone tag. Waxy, unstable, and the raw form of the mod's first reagent.

chain.title: Making It Behave
chain.desc: White phosphorus through a mixer. The stable allotrope, and the one the first synthesis actually consumes.

chain.title: A Single Strike
chain.desc: Mechanical crafting red phosphorus onto sticks. A single-use firestarter by its own tooltip, and it mills straight back into phosphorus if you change your mind.

chain.title: Buy It From Farmers
chain.desc: The mod's own tooltip tells you where this comes from - villager trade, not a recipe. It is the plant everything downstream is extracted from, so the first bottleneck is a farmer, not a machine.

chain.title: Growing Your Own
chain.desc: Crafted from ephedra, or milled out of it alongside the extract. Plant them and the supply stops depending on a villager's mood.

chain.title: The Extract
chain.desc: Milling ephedra gives seeds and this. Also recoverable by milling the boxed pharmacy version, which is the industrial route once you have a village to buy out.

chain.title: Clay, Crushed
chain.desc: Crushing wheels on a clay ball or a whole clay block. The cheapest input in the mod and the start of its only reusable catalyst.

chain.title: Not Consumed On Use
chain.desc: Bits packed into a chunk, chunks packed into the catalyst. Its tooltip is the important part - it comes back out of every reaction it drives, so you only ever make a handful.

chain.title: Boiling Off the Water
chain.desc: Mixing water with the aluminosilicate catalyst. Salt concentrate, and the only source of the mod's halogen.

chain.title: Purple Vapour
chain.desc: Brine through the mixer. Together with red phosphorus it is one half of the reduction that makes the first product.

chain.title: Poured and Cooling
chain.desc: Spouting Liquid White Stuff into an empty tray. The intermediate state between fluid and product - a tray full of something that has not set yet.

chain.title: The First Batch
chain.desc: Pressing a filled tray gives the product and hands the tray back. End of phase one: water, iodine, pseudophedrine and red phosphorus in, one crude solid out.

chain.title: Metal to Powder
chain.desc: Crushing wheels on any copper ingot. Half of the mod's second catalyst, and the point where phase two starts needing a real ore chain.

chain.title: The Second Catalyst
chain.desc: Crushed copper and crushed zinc, shapeless. It survives both the electrolysis and the methanol synthesis, so one is enough to run the whole line.

chain.title: Splitting Water
chain.desc: Mixing water over the copper-zinc catalyst throws off hydrogen and oxygen at once, and returns the catalyst. Two gases from one basin, which is why this recipe sits at the centre of phase two.

chain.title: Wood Alcohol
chain.desc: Hydrogen, coal and the copper-zinc catalyst in a mixer. The first of the two feedstocks the amine needs.

chain.title: Fixed From Crops
chain.desc: Mechanical crafting potatoes, beetroot and beetroot seeds. An absurd way to get nitrogen and entirely in keeping with the rest of the mod.

chain.title: Ammonia Meets Alcohol
chain.desc: Ammonia from nitrogen, methanol from hydrogen, and the aluminosilicate catalyst to push them together. The second half of the blue synthesis.

chain.title: Out of an Apple
chain.desc: Crushing wheels on a plain apple. Mixed with water it becomes phenylacetic acid, which is the other feedstock.

chain.title: Two Streams Converge
chain.desc: Phenylacetic acid from cyanide, acetic anhydride from oxygen and sugar, mixed together. Building it means both halves of the electrolysis are finally being used.

chain.title: The Blue Pour
chain.desc: Methylamine and phenylacetone mixed into Liquid Blue Stuff, then spouted into a tray. Four separate synthesis lines have to be running at once to keep this tray filling.

chain.title: Ninety-Nine Point One
chain.desc: Pressing the blue tray. The end of the mod: everything it adds exists to reach this one item, and the tray comes back for the next batch.

notes: Verified against createbb-1.20.1-3.2.2.jar (Forge, minecraft [1.20.1, 1.21), create dependency declared). NOT ON MODRINTH - this is a CurseForge-only mod, project 635620, slug create-broken-bad, display name 'Create: Broken Bad'. Modrinth search for 'createbb' returns nothing and so does CurseForge's own search for that string; the mod was found only by matching the moddb consensus item list (cyanide, pseudophedrine, methylamine, blue_meth_tray) against a CurseForge search for 'broken bad'. Record the slug: create-broken-bad. ID SET IS 36 = 35 item models plus one blockstate-only id. All 35 item models have a lang key (30 item.createbb.*, 5 block.createbb.*), and createbb:ephedra_crop_block has a blockstate and a block.createbb.ephedra_crop_block key but NO item model - it is the planted crop, and its loot table is what gives the ephedra back, so it is counted as registered but is not questable. THE MOD IS ALL CREATE PROCESSING: of 48 recipe files, only 11 are vanilla crafting; the rest are create:mixing (12), create:crushing (6), create:filling (2), create:pressing (2), create:milling (4), create:compacting (1) and create:mechanical_crafting (2). No forge:conditional wrapper appears anywhere in the jar and there is no mod_loaded gate on anything, so every item here is reachable with only Create installed. TWO DEAD RECIPES FOUND: data/createbb/recipes/misc/smelt_copper_dust.json and smelt_zinc_dust.json smelt createbb:copper_dust and createbb:zinc_dust, but neither id exists in this jar - there is no model, no lang key and no texture for either. They are leftovers from an earlier version where the crushing outputs were called dusts rather than crushed_copper / crushed_zinc, and they will simply fail to load their ingredient. Nothing depends on them, so nothing is lost. DROPPED: createbb:ephedra_crop_block only, for the reason above. Nothing else was dropped - all 35 item-model ids are obtainable. TWO OBTAINABILITY POINTS THAT A RECIPE-ONLY SCAN GETS WRONG, both checked by reading the jar directly. (1) createbb:ephedra has NO recipe file at all. It is still obtainable, and I read data/createbb/loot_tables/blocks/ephedra_crop_block.json to prove it: the crop drops createbb:ephedra when its age property is 3 and createbb:ephedra_seeds otherwise. The first ephedra comes from a villager (its tooltip is literally 'Buy it from farmers'), after which the crop is self-sustaining. It is safe as a chain step. (2) TEN of the 36 ids have no recipe file either - acetic_anhydride_bucket, ammonia_bucket, hydrogen_bucket, liquid_blue_stuff_bucket, liquid_white_stuff_bucket, methanol_bucket, methylamine_bucket, oxygen_bucket, phenylacetic_acid_bucket and phenylacetone_bucket. All ten are the bucket items of the mod's ten registered fluids (fluid.createbb.acetic_anhydride, ammonia, hydrogen, liquid_blue_stuff, liquid_white_stuff, methanol, methylamine, oxygen, phenylacetic_acid, phenylacetone) and Create fills any of them at a spout or item drain from the basin that produced the fluid - the mixing recipes output the FLUID, and bucketing it is the intended way to hold it. Five of them (hydrogen, methanol, methylamine, phenylacetone and the two liquid_stuff ones) are used as chain or wheel entries because they are the only stackable, questable form of a synthesis step; if the pack prefers not to ask for buckets, swap those steps for the solid product that follows them. ORDERING CONFLICTS vs moddb consensus (26 entries, all 26 id-verified as far as they go, but see the renames below): the consensus positions are broadly plausible on the chemistry but wrong at both ends. (1) It opens with trapped_brass_call_bell 0.0 and tray 0.083 and only reaches aluminosilicate_catalyst at 0.283 - but brine 0.565 is create:mixing water OVER the aluminosilicate catalyst, and iodine 0.774 comes from brine, so the catalyst has to precede both by a wide margin; it was moved to step 9 and brine and iodine follow immediately. (2) It puts cyanide at 0.202 and phenylacetic_acid_bucket at 0.238, ahead of copper_zinc_catalyst 0.625 and methanol_bucket 0.524 - the acid does only need cyanide and water, so that is legal, but phenylacetone (0.81) needs acetic anhydride, which needs createbb:oxygen, which only exists as a by-product of the electrolysis that requires the copper-zinc catalyst. The catalyst was moved ahead of the whole phase-two block. (3) It puts white_stuff at 0.952 and blue_stuff at 1.0 adjacent to each other; the jar's own folder layout disagrees - recipes/phase1/ makes white stuff and recipes/phase2/ makes blue stuff, and phase 1 needs no metal at all while phase 2 needs copper, zinc and coal. The two products were separated so phase 1 finishes at step 13 and phase 2 runs 14 to 23. Recipe graph and the jar's phase1/phase2 folder split preferred over consensus in all three cases. CONSENSUS IDS THAT DO NOT EXIST IN THIS JAR - flag these upstream: createbb:blue_meth_tray and createbb:white_meth_tray appear in moddb at 0.917 and 1.0, but this jar registers them as createbb:blue_stuff_tray and createbb:white_stuff_tray. The mod was evidently renamed between the version moddb harvested and 3.2.2, and any book built on the moddb ids alone would ship two broken tasks. PARENT ASSUMPTIONS: crushing wheels, a mixer with a blaze burner, a mechanical press, a millstone, a spout, a mechanical crafter array, iron plates, brass plates and brass ingots, plus Create's limestone (the crushing recipe accepts either create:limestone or anything in create:stone_types/limestone). Non-chain curiosities worth a reward slot: createbb:match is a one-shot firestarter, createbb:white_phosphorus is in the createbb:tnt_powders tag and crafts vanilla TNT with sand, and the brass call bell has a trapped redstone variant.
